Full Statement: Theatre K-8
Creating
Students will generate and conceptualize artistic ideas and work.
Imagine: Students will conceive plot, characters, dialogue, and stage movement through exploration.
K-2: Beginner
Level A
I can imitate the actions of the characters in a familiar story.
Level B
I can adapt the behavior of a character in a familiar story.
I can imagine how changing the plot of a story will lead to a different ending.
3-5: Emerging
Level C
I can collaborate with others to improvise dialogue for a scene.
I can collaborate with others to plan and improvise the plot, characters, and dialogue for a scene.
Level D

6-8: Intermediate
Level E

Level F

Level A

Level C

Level A
